title: Master FRQ: the clinic scheduler
prompt:
25-minute FRQ. Implement the `Clinic` class (four behaviors, no topic announced):

- constructor takes the number of rooms
- `arrive(String patient)` adds the patient to the waitlist unless already waiting (returns true on success, false on duplicate)
- `room()` assigns the waitlisted patient at the FRONT to a free room if any exist (rooms are slots, like lockers; returns the 1-based room number or -1) — the patient leaves the waitlist
- `waiting()` reports the waitlist size
- `freeRooms()` reports unoccupied room count

Implement the full class. Bank order: arrive, waiting/freeRooms, then room.

tests.name: clinic frq
tests.hint: Fuses three banked patterns: the no-duplicate insert (studio), the locker allocation (lowest free room), and a front-queue removal.
